Home / About

A contractor for the physical side of the deal

We do the field work that sits behind procurement contracts: finding material, preparing it, clearing it and delivering it.

Who we are

What DC Consulting does

Procurement firms and trading houses are good at winning mandates from large buyers. Delivering on those mandates in producing regions needs people, facilities and relationships on the ground. DC Consulting provides that capability.

We work across rare earth minerals, crude oil and gemstones, and take on other strategic materials case by case. We are a contractor, not a trading house: our job is to execute the physical delivery of a contract that someone else holds.

Where we fit

Who does what in a typical contract

Many deals pass through three layers. We sit in the last one, and we do not go around the layers above us.

Tier 1

End buyer

A manufacturer, refinery, government institution or other organisation that needs the material.

↓ gives a purchasing mandate
Tier 2

Procurement firm or trading house

Holds the buyer relationship and the commercial terms. Needs someone to execute on the ground.

↓ subcontracts physical execution
Tier 3

DC Consulting

Sources, processes, documents and ships. Bound by a written non-circumvention and confidentiality agreement.

Who we serve

Four kinds of client

Procurement firms

Subcontract origin-to-port execution while keeping your end-buyer relationship private.

Corporations & manufacturers

Secure feedstock such as oxides, concentrates or distillates through a verifiable supply route.

Government & institutions

Strategic reserve and energy supply mandates, with full documentation for public-sector review.

Trading houses & refiners

Physical lifting, blending and shipping support for cargoes you have already contracted.
